features.quote: tools are `list_files`, `read_file`, `write_file`, `delete_file`, `run_shell`, plus two terminals: `give_up` and `submit`
features.justification_quote: let the agent express intent cleanly, which sharpens classification

features.quote: a fixed step budget (`max_steps`, default 12), OpenAI-style messages, terminating on `give_up`/`submit`
features.justification_quote: Step budget both bounds cost and creates the `excessive_effort` signal

features.quote: `Workspace._abs` refuses paths outside the root so a buggy/malicious agent can't scribble on the host FS
features.justification_quote: so a buggy/malicious agent can't scribble on the host FS during a run
